name: Empty Bowl
description: A 15-minute memory narrative for your break. You manage what a fading AI remembers — delete one card, and what it says next changes. The free full version (4 chapters, 3 endings, ~90 min) lives on itch.io.
releaseNotes: First release: 8 memories, two chapters, one ending, ~15 minutes. Evolved from the hash-chain idea in dbx-sql-guard.

zh-CN.name: 空碗 · 十五分钟
zh-CN.description: 十五分钟的记忆叙事摸鱼游戏。你替一个正在失忆的 AI 决定记住什么——删掉一张纸片，它后面说的话就变。完整版（四章三个结局，约 90 分钟）免费，在 itch.io。
